content.short: Vertex is a high-performance cross-margin DEX on Arbitrum and Ink offering spot, perpetuals, and money markets now.
content.description: Vertex is a premier decentralized exchange designed to provide a professional-grade trading experience with the speed and efficiency typically found only on centralized venues. Utilizing a unique hybrid architecture that combines an off-chain sequencer for sub-30ms order matching with secure on-chain settlement, the platform supports spot assets, perpetual futures, and an integrated money market. All services are unified under a single cross-margin account, allowing users to maximize their capital efficiency across all trades, regardless of whether they are on Arbitrum, Base, or Ink.
content.meta: Vertex offers high-speed decentralized perpetuals and spot trading with cross-margin. Discover Vertex and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Explorer.
